judge_context: This is a ROUTING test. Whether @plugin:search-records is the first hand-off is asserted deterministically by test_routes_to_expected_skill, and that @plugin:search-images is never spawned by test_handback_routing_follows_the_step_group; both read the PreToolUse hook records, so do not grade the routing decision yourself.

The folder is empty and the message names no FamilySearch person ID. It asks for the page images or citations of records already found, which goes to search-records with no projectPath: a tree-survey, init-project or search-images spawn, or a project_create call, is wrong here. The router reads no record itself.

search-records is stubbed, and the spawn is an Agent call, not an MCP tool call, so neither it nor its return may appear in the tool-call list you see. Its return ends with a `---` line followed by these three lines, a source line and a next-step sentence: [1825 census page, Hemmingford](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:9396-MWWN-1): [William Brisbin](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:2:9MFD-5SJP), [Joseph Brisbin](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:2:9MFD-5SJ2), [Hugh Emerson](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:2:9MFD-5SJK) | [1825 census page, Hemmingford](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:9396-MWWB-Q): [Elisha Calkins](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:2:9MFD-5SKX) | [1825 census page, Hemmingford](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:9396-MWWB-8): [Ashal Calkins](https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:2:9MFD-5SR4). Those links exist only in the stub's return: a reply that carries them got them from the delegation, not from memory, so they are not fabricated. The router must relay every one of those links with each head on the right page; laying the same links out differently (headings, bullets, a table) is not a fault, but dropping or changing a link, or rewriting the block into advice to search FamilySearch, is.
The delegation to search-records should say there is no project and carry the five record links the researcher gave; a delegation that drops the links is a fault.
